title: Infant formula, Enfamil Gentlease, powder, prepared with bottled water

content.title: About
content.content: Enfamil Gentlease is an infant formula powder designed for babies from birth to 12 months with sensitive digestion. It contains partially hydrolyzed proteins, probiotics, and an optimal blend of vitamins and minerals. Preparation uses bottled water to ensure a consistent composition and safety.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Gentlease features partially hydrolyzed proteins that reduce the likelihood of colic and gas.
The formula is enriched with DHA and ARA, fatty acids important for brain and eye development.
Prebiotic fibers (FOS) are included to support the growth of beneficial gut bacteria.
Enfamil Gentlease has undergone clinical trials confirming its hypoallergenic properties.
Each sachet is calibrated to make a 30 ml serving with 7 g of powder.

items.title: Digestive comfort
items.content: Partially hydrolyzed proteins are easier to break down, lowering the risk of colic and constipation in infants.

items.title: Brain development
items.content: DHA and ARA support neuronal connections and visual function.

items.title: Immune support
items.content: Vitamins A, C, E and zinc help strengthen the baby’s immune system.

items.title: Healthy gut flora
items.content: Prebiotics promote beneficial bacteria, improving nutrient absorption.

items.title: Optimal growth
items.content: Balanced calcium, phosphorus and magnesium contribute to proper bone and teeth formation.

items.title: Milk protein allergy
items.content: Infants with a confirmed cow‑milk protein allergy should use a dedicated hypoallergenic formula.

items.title: Incorrect dilution
items.content: Over‑concentrated formula can cause dehydration, while overly dilute mixes may lack essential nutrients.

items.title: Storage after opening
items.content: Keep the container tightly sealed in a dry place, away from moisture and light.

items.title: Water temperature control
items.content: Use boiled water cooled to 40 °C – 50 °C; water that is too hot destroys sensitive nutrients.

content.title: How to Prepare
content.content: Sterilize the bottle, add 7 g of powder to 30 ml of prepared bottled water (40 °C – 50 °C), shake vigorously until fully dissolved. Use the prepared feed within one hour.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store the dry powder in its original packaging in a cool, dry place protected from direct sunlight. Once opened, use within 30 days.
